_note: Hand-curated companion to scripts/fetch-element-images.mjs. Captions are Traditional Chinese descriptions written from each Wikimedia Commons file description. 'exclude' lists images that do not show the element itself (or cannot be redistributed as a thumbnail), with the reason.
